exception_entry.not_applicable: FormalSimple has no CSR/trap controller; its trap output reports a terminal formal halt.

interrupt_entry.not_applicable: FormalSimple drives rvfi_intr to zero and has no interrupt controller.

trap_return.not_applicable: FormalSimple has no privileged return controller.

instruction_memory.unsupported: Compressed fetch-response address pairing needs a project tracker.

trap_pc_chain.unsupported: FormalSimple reports terminal halts, not trap target and return transitions.
